# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_PINCH_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon (8 EMA and 55 EMA) contracts to a width below 0.1% of price, volatility is compressed and a bullish engulfing candle closing above the short‑term EMA signals an imminent expansion upward. This setup aims to capture the edge from low‑volatility contraction followed by aggressive bullish momentum on SPY 0DTE puts.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** If (8 EMA - 55 EMA) / close < 0.001 (ribbon width <0.1% of price) **and** the prior bar is a bullish engulfing candle (close > open and close > prior high) **and** close > 8 EMA, enter long at the close of the engulfing bar.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at the low of the engulfing bar (chart‑stop). Take profit 1 (TP1) at 2.0R from risk. After TP1, trail the runner using a structure stop placed at the most recent higher high.  
**Regime filters:** VIX < 18, time window 09:45–12:00 ET, and price making higher lows (HL) on the 5‑min chart to confirm a micro‑uptrend.
